pros: Funding by card, transfer, PayPal and Skrill.
cons: Marketing numbers that the fine print walks back.
No independent audit of the models.
Broker relationship described vaguely.
Registration details not stated up front.
redFlags: A score and a community mood wearing the same number.
Support figures that contradict each other.
Template placeholders left unrendered.

faqs.q: Is Monty Trading safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$200, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

bottomLine: Monty Trading is a standard-issue AI trading desk with the usual strengths and the usual omissions. None of the omissions are dealbreakers - they are conditions.
We scored Monty Trading 4.6 out of 5. The deductions come from the disclosure gaps, not the mechanics. With the US$200 minimum and the demo as guardrails, the risk stays yours to control.
